script.problem: It has 37 words. A meaning is about 30 words at most.
It has 3 sentences. A meaning is 1 or 2 sentences.

terra.problem: The meaning says Judah would keep its power to rule as a fact, but Clarke also gives the different interpretation that Judah would remain a distinct tribe. Present these as differing interpretations. Also, explain “Messiah” in words a 10-year-old can understand.
